cards.title: Navigation with <nav>
cards.body: `<nav>` wraps the main links of a site, like its menu.

hi.title: <nav> se navigation
hi.body: `<nav>` site ke main links ko gherta hai, jaise uska menu.

cards.title: Links inside your site
cards.body: An `href` that starts with `/` goes to another page on the same site, like `/about`.

hi.title: Apni site ke andar links
hi.body: Jo `href` `/` se shuru hota hai woh usi site ke doosre page par jaata hai, jaise `/about`.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The Contact link shows up, but clicking it goes nowhere. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: A link needs an `href` to know where to go, like `Contact`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Contact link dikhta hai, par click karne par kahin nahi jaata. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Link ko pata hona chahiye kahan jaana hai, iske liye `href` chahiye, jaise `Contact`.

check.question: Where should a site's main menu links go?
check.explanation: `<nav>` is made for the main navigation links.

hi.question: Site ke main menu links kahan jaane chahiye?
hi.explanation: `<nav>` main navigation links ke liye hi bana hai.

exercise.prompt: Make a `<nav>` with three links that say `Home`, `Blog` and `About`.
exercise.promptHi: Ek `<nav>` banao jismein teen links hon jo `Home`, `Blog` aur `About` kahen.

checks.label: The `<nav>` has at least three links
checks.labelHi: `<nav>` mein kam se kam teen links hain
